title: ApprovalRecord v0
description: Josh's decision on one exact consequential action (T11/T12 item 4; T19 item 4). Issued only by the T19 notifier (E1); verified by the PolicyEngine (C1). Any change to the bound action voids it. Authority comes only from issuer_signature by the trusted E1 issuer key; decided_by/channel are signed claims, not proof.

action_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the BoundAction (see approval.py).

screenshot_ref.description: Required by T38 for browser/computer acts; evidence store reference.

issuer_key_id.description: Which pinned E1 issuer key signed this record.

issuer_signature.description: Issuer signature over the canonical JSON of every other field (approval.signing_payload).
